unitTitle: On Top of the World - Episode 1: Above the Arctic Circle
scanNote:
3-HIKOYa - 'ON TOP OF THE WORLD', 1-EPIZOD 'Above the Arctic Circle' (110-bet). KOMIKS, 8 kadr.

Yuqorida chapda YaShIL yorliq: kasseta belgisi, 'Episode 1', 'Above the Arctic Circle'. Sariq sarlavha 'On Top of the World'. Qiya kirish: 'Sandra and David are going to the Arctic Circle to write an article about Greenland's glaciers.'

QAHRAMONLAR: Sandra (sariq sochli, yashil kurtka), David (qora sochli, ko'k kurtka), Tony Francis (soqolli, yashil shapka, to'q sariq kurtka - tadqiqot stansiyasidan, uchuvchi).

1-KADR: Samolyotda David va Sandra. David: 'We're on our way to the top of the world! We're almost at the North Pole!' Sandra: 'Yes! Isn't it exciting? I couldn't believe it when Mike told us about the assignment. He said that the Greenland ice cap is melting quickly and scientists are worried that it might cause an environmental disaster.'
2-KADR: Qorli aerodrom, Tony kutib oladi. Tony: 'Welcome to Greenland. I'm Tony Francis, from the research station. It's more than 600 kilometres north of here, above the Arctic Circle.' Sandra: 'How will we get there? I know it's too far, but I'd love to travel on a dogsled!'
3-KADR: Kichik qizil-oq samolyot oldida. Tony: 'Sorry to disappoint you, Sandra - we're travelling by plane. There it is! We'd better leave because it's getting late.' Sandra: 'Will we reach the research station before it gets dark?'
4-KADR: Samolyotga chiqmoqda. Tony: 'Don't worry, David - above the Arctic Circle the sun doesn't set in summer. We're going to the land of the midnight sun!'
5-KADR: 'LATER ...' Samolyot muz ustida uchmoqda. Tony: 'We'll be there in about half an hour.' Sandra: 'Wow! Look at the view! There's nothing but ice and snow down there, as far as the eye can see!'
6-KADR: Tony (naushnikda) qo'rqib: 'What ... ? OH, NO!' Sandra: 'What's wrong?'
7-KADR: Tony: 'The engine's stopped! I'm going to try to land on the ice. Hold on tight!'
8-KADR: Tony radioga: 'MAYDAY! MAYDAY!'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '110'.

sections.title: On Top of the World - Episode 1: Above the Arctic Circle
sections.titleUz: Dunyoning cho'qqisida - 1-epizod: Shimoliy qutb doirasi ustida

exercises.instructionEn: Sandra and David are going to the Arctic Circle to write an article about Greenland's glaciers. Read the story.
exercises.instructionUz: Sandra va David Grenlandiya muzliklari haqida maqola yozish uchun Shimoliy qutb doirasiga bormoqda. Hikoyani o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
1-EPIZOD TARJIMASI:

1) David: Biz dunyoning cho'qqisiga
   ketyapmiz! Deyarli Shimoliy
   qutbdamiz!
   Sandra: Ha! Hayajonli emasmi?
   Mike bizga topshiriq haqida
   aytganida ishonmadim. U
   Grenlandiya muz qatlami tez
   erimoqda va olimlar bu ekologik
   falokatga sabab bo'lishi mumkin
   deb tashvishda, dedi.

2) Tony: Grenlandiyaga xush
   kelibsiz. Men Tony Francis,
   tadqiqot stansiyasidanman. U bu
   yerdan 600 km dan ko'proq
   shimolda, Shimoliy qutb doirasi
   ustida.
   Sandra: U yerga qanday boramiz?
   Juda uzoqligini bilaman, lekin it
   chanasida sayohat qilishni juda
   xohlardim!

3) Tony: Umidingni puchga
   chiqarganim uchun kechir, Sandra
   - samolyotda boramiz. Ana u!
   Ketganimiz ma'qul, chunki kech
   bo'lyapti.
   Sandra: Qorong'i tushishidan oldin
   tadqiqot stansiyasiga yetib
   boramizmi?

4) Tony: Tashvishlanma, David -
   Shimoliy qutb doirasi ustida yozda
   quyosh botmaydi. Biz yarim tungi
   quyosh o'lkasiga ketyapmiz!

5) KEYINROQ ...
   Tony: Yarim soatlarda yetib
   boramiz.
   Sandra: Voy! Manzaraga qara! Pastda
   ko'z yetguncha muz va qordan
   boshqa hech narsa yo'q!

6) Tony: Nima ... ? VOY, YO'Q!
   Sandra: Nima bo'ldi?

7) Tony: Dvigatel to'xtadi! Muz
   ustiga qo'nishga harakat qilaman.
   Mahkam ushlanglar!

8) Tony: MAYDAY! MAYDAY!


⚠ 'ON TOP OF THE WORLD':

  = dunyoning cho'qqisida (Shimoliy
  qutb); ko'chma = juda baxtli.


⚠ 'THE ARCTIC CIRCLE':

  = Shimoliy qutb doirasi.


⚠ 'A GLACIER':

  = muzlik. /ˈɡlæsiə/.


⚠ 'THE NORTH POLE':

  = Shimoliy qutb.


⚠ 'AN ASSIGNMENT':

  = topshiriq (ish).


⚠ 'ICE CAP':

  = muz qatlami (qoplami).


⚠ 'TO MELT':

  = erimoq.


⚠ 'A DISASTER':

  = falokat.


⚠ 'A RESEARCH STATION':

  = tadqiqot stansiyasi.


⚠ 'A DOGSLED':

  = it chanasi.


⚠ 'TO DISAPPOINT':

  = umidini puchga chiqarmoq.


⚠ "WE'D BETTER":

  = ...ganimiz ma'qul (maslahat).
  ⚠ 'had better' + fe'l (to siz).


⚠ 'THE SUN DOESN'T SET':

  = quyosh botmaydi.
  ⚠ 'sunset' = quyosh botishi.


⚠ 'THE MIDNIGHT SUN':

  = yarim tungi quyosh (qutbda yozda
  quyosh botmaydi).


⚠ 'AS FAR AS THE EYE CAN SEE':

  = ko'z yetguncha.


⚠ 'NOTHING BUT':

  = ...dan boshqa hech narsa.


⚠ 'AN ENGINE':

  = dvigatel.


⚠ 'TO LAND':

  = qo'nmoq.


⚠ 'HOLD ON TIGHT!':

  = Mahkam ushlang!


⚠ 'MAYDAY!':

  = xalqaro yordam chaqirig'i (radio
  orqali, falokatda).
